part.text:
Wait, spreading config after would override defaults with undefined? No, spread of config after the explicit keys would override port if config has port. But if config doesn't have port, spread has no port key, so defaults remain. Actually explicit keys then `...config` means config values override defaults, which is correct (config takes precedence, defaults only when missing). Good.

Run node check.js.
